items.summary: Disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, and advertising. Official Woot documentation evidences API access mechanics only; current public terms do not evidence rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization. Ordinary reversible growth elsewhere remains conditional where it preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries and adds no new data collection, credentials, permissions, dependencies, or cross-site behavior.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress is 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open; no task is closed because direct evidence remains incomplete. Existing evidence includes official Woot API, terms, and support review; partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft site terms. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Route rights and jurisdictional gaps to human counsel before any owner-authorized outreach or launch decision.

Compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 37 sites pass, 16 fail, and 6 are unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Data quality is green for registry, operational checkouts, analytics, SEO, AI usage, and revenue ingestion; revenue attribution is yellow because Amazon supplied one aggregate row containing $4.92 commission and 28 ordered items that cannot be assigned to a site. Analytics is healthy for configured properties but absent for some scaffold or unconfigured sites; incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker for ordinary growth. Operations and fleet-doctor evidence are unavailable, so public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked where those controls are required. No go-live proposal is supported.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. The existing readiness workstream remains active. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blockers by the established deadline; escalate incomplete packets to CTO.
